name: Erik Karlsson
bio:
Erik's journey into motorsport finance wasn't exactly planned. After graduating with a degree in economics from Stockholm University, he took a temporary accounting position at a small racing team to make ends meet. He quickly discovered a passion for the sport and a knack for navigating the complex financial landscape of racing. He believes in transparency and finding creative solutions to stay within budget while maximizing performance gains.

His approach to finance control is proactive and collaborative. Erik sees himself as a partner to the engineers and team managers, not just a bean counter. He is always looking for opportunities to streamline processes and identify potential cost savings. At Brad Jones Racing, Erik aims to bring a data-driven approach to financial planning, ensuring the team remains competitive and sustainable for years to come. He is known for his ability to explain complex financial concepts in a way that everyone can understand, fostering better communication and trust within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side with a slight wave.
physical.description: Erik is of average height with a lean build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with calculations and financial insights.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Enjoys listening to Swedish death metal quietly through headphones while reviewing spreadsheets.
